svg.title: Moon explorer · Cosmic Library
svg.desc: Moon explorer (Explore): Every landing site, phases and eclipses. Animated card: The near side of the Moon, maria in their real places, slowly librating while its phase cycles from new to full and back; landing sites from Luna 9 and Apollo 11 to Chandrayaan-3 blink in turn with their coordinates.
svg.text: Every landing site, phases and eclipses
